resources.name: CloudFront

resources.name: CloudWatch

The free tier includes 10 custom metrics, 10 alarms, 1,000 API requests, and 5GB of log data ingestion per month. It collects operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications, and services running on AWS.

resources.name: CodeBuild
resources.description: AWS CodeBuild is a fully managed continuous integration service that compiles source code, runs tests, and produces deployable software packages. The free tier provides 100 build minutes per month on general-purpose instances (build.general1.small). It supports multiple programming languages out of the box, custom build environments via Docker, and integrates with GitHub, Bitbucket, and CodeCommit.

resources.name: CodeCommit
resources.description: AWS CodeCommit is a secure, highly scalable, fully managed source control service that hosts private Git repositories. The free tier includes unlimited private repositories and 50GB of storage per month for up to 5 users. It eliminates the need to operate your own source control system or worry about scaling capacity, and integrates seamlessly with IAM for fine-grained access control.

resources.name: CodePipeline
resources.description: AWS CodePipeline is a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) service for fast and reliable application and infrastructure updates. The free tier includes one active pipeline per month with unlimited runs. It automates the build, test, and deploy phases of your release process every time there is a code change, based on the release model you define.

resources.name: DynamoDB
resources.description: Amazon DynamoDB is a serverless, NoSQL key-value database designed for single-digit millisecond performance at any scale. The permanently free tier provides 25GB of storage, 25 provisioned write capacity units (WCU), and 25 read capacity units (RCU), enough for 200M reads and 200M writes per month. Features on-demand capacity mode, global tables for multi-region replication, and DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for in-memory caching.

resources.name: EC2
resources.description: Amazon EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud) provides scalable virtual servers in the cloud. The free tier includes 750 hours per month of t2.micro (1 vCPU, 1GB RAM) or t3.micro instances for 12 months, running Linux, Windows Server, or macOS. EC2 is the foundational compute service for AWS, supporting auto-scaling groups, load balancers, spot instances for cost savings, and extensive instance type selection for every workload.

resources.name: EBS
resources.description: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) provides persistent block storage volumes for use with EC2 instances. The free tier includes 30GB of General Purpose SSD (gp3) storage for 12 months, plus 2 million I/O operations free. EBS volumes are automatically replicated within an Availability Zone and support point-in-time snapshots to S3 for backup and disaster recovery.

resources.name: Elastic Load Balancing
resources.description: AWS Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets, including EC2 instances, containers, and IP addresses. The free tier includes 750 hours per month of Application Load Balancer or Network Load Balancer for 12 months. ELB supports health checks, SSL/TLS offloading, and sticky sessions, and is essential for building highly available, fault-tolerant applications.

resources.name: RDS
resources.description: Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service) makes it easy to set up, operate, and scale a relational database in the cloud. The free tier includes 750 hours per month of db.t2.micro or db.t3.micro instances and 20GB of General Purpose SSD storage for 12 months. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server Express, and Oracle. Handles routine database tasks such as provisioning, patching, backup, recovery, and failure detection.

resources.name: S3
resources.description: Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service) is the industry-leading object storage service for scalability, data availability, security, and performance. The free tier includes 5GB of Standard storage, 20,000 GET requests, and 2,000 PUT requests monthly for 12 months, plus 2,000 PUT and 20,000 GET requests permanently free. S3 provides 99.999999999% (11 9's) durability and integrates with virtually every AWS service.

resources.name: Glacier
resources.description: Amazon S3 Glacier is an extremely low-cost storage service for data archival and long-term backup. The permanently free tier includes 10GB of Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage per month. Retrieval options range from milliseconds (Expedited) to hours (Standard) to days (Bulk), with costs decreasing as retrieval time increases. Ideal for regulatory compliance archives, disaster recovery data, and cold data that is rarely accessed.

resources.name: Lambda
resources.description: AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that runs your code in response to events without provisioning or managing servers. The permanently free tier includes 1 million free requests per month and 400,000 GB-seconds of compute time per month. Supports Node.js, Python, Go, Java, C#, and Ruby. Lambda functions can be triggered by over 200 AWS services and event sources, making it the backbone of serverless architectures.

resources.name: SNS
resources.description: Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) is a fully managed pub/sub messaging service for coordinating the delivery of messages to subscribing endpoints and clients. The permanently free tier includes 1 million requests, 1,000 email deliveries, and 100 SMS deliveries per month. SNS supports message delivery to SQS queues, Lambda functions, HTTP/HTTPS endpoints, email, and mobile push notifications (iOS, Android, Fire OS).

resources.name: SES
resources.description: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) is a cost-effective, flexible, and scalable email sending and receiving service for developers. When running from an EC2 instance or Lambda function, the free tier allows sending 3,000 emails per day for free. SES supports both transactional emails (password resets, order confirmations) and marketing emails, with detailed sending statistics, easy DKIM setup, and high deliverability rates.

resources.name: SQS
resources.description: Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) is a fully managed message queuing service for decoupling and scaling microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications. The permanently free tier includes 1 million requests per month. SQS offers two types: Standard queues (unlimited throughput, at-least-once delivery) and FIFO queues (exactly-once processing, ordered messages). Eliminates the complexity of managing message-oriented middleware.
